mentions.name: feocask
mentions.description: A Rust port of the Erlang Bitcask key-value store with a strict no-lock design built on Tokio channels, using Vector Clocks and Hybrid Logical Clocks. It is safe across any number of threads at the cost of N^2 reconciliation and extra drive space, with future plans for optional automatic distribution across multiple nodes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been porting over my favorite Erlang library "Bitcask" to Rust.

https://git.sr.ht/~tombert/feocask

Called "feocask" cuz feo means "ugly" in Spanish and FeO to mean Iron Oxide for Rust.
